1996 Pro Forma Actual 1996 Pro Forma Actual

NOTE: (a) Results for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 1996, include a $26 million and $79 million decrease, respectively in Sales; a $7 million and $16 million decrease, respectively, in operating profit; and, a $5 million and $9 million decrease, respectively, in net income from currency translation effects worldwide as compared to the 1995 pro forma results.

(b) The pro forma results reflect the acquisition of CBI Industries Inc (CBI) as though it occurred on January 1, 1995 after adjustments for the impact of interest on acquisition debt, increased depreciation and amortization to reflect the purchase price allocation, and the elimination of assets held for sale.
(c) The quarter and nine months ended September 30, 1996, includes $5 million and $15 million, respectively, in selling, general and administrative costs associated with acquisitions other than CBI.

(d) Depreciation and amortization for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 1996 and the pro forma quarter and nine months ended September 30, 1995, reflect an additional $3 million and $9 million, respectively, for purchase accounting adjustments versus amounts initially included in Praxair's Form 8-K filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on March 8, 1996.

(e) The 1996 first quarter CBI integration charges are related to the integration of CBI's Liquid Carbonic business into Praxair; primarily severance and lease termination costs. Excluding this charge, operating profit for the nine months ended September 30, 1996 was $534 million and net income was $239 million.

(f) Income taxes for the quarter ended September 30, 1996 include year-to-date tax benefits related to Praxair's South American operations that were partially offset in other segments. As a result, the consolidated effective tax rate for the quarter decreased to 25.2 percent and Minority interests increased by $2 million related to previous quarters. Excluding the effect of the first quarter CBI integration charges, income taxes for the nine months ended September 30, 1996 were $103 million (26.5 percent effective tax rate).
(g) Based on 162,315,717 and 157,499,700 shares for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 1996 (144,832,467 and 143,232,173 shares for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 1995).
